en: A color image of a circular, modernist pavilion with a flat overhanging roof and a low green dome. Wide semicircular steps lead up to glass doors, with many people walking up and down, dressed in mid‑20th‑century clothing. Trees and a park-like setting surround the building. On the building's façade there is Cyrillic text, and a large blue letter "M" stands on the roof near the entrance.
